source_limitations: The full 195-evaluation benchmark payload is withheld by the publisher to reduce training contamination; six canonical examples are public.
The pinned aggregate table does not publish exact harness package versions, historical model-serving revisions, timeout/budget policy, or repetition count.
The source publishes aggregate accuracy, confidence intervals where available, cost, duration, and N; W1 does not infer undocumented aggregation semantics.
The source runner binds harness labels to latch-eval-tools adapter functions and uses task-specific deterministic graders, but this does not establish standalone harness equivalence outside scBench.
